# Re-load the capital dataset and inspect its contents
capital_df = pd.read_csv('/data/capital.csv')
capital_df.head()

# Replace commas with periods in numeric columns
capital_df[numeric_columns] = capital_df[numeric_columns].apply(lambda x: x.str.replace(',', '.').astype(float))

# Drop rows with missing values
capital_df = capital_df.dropna()

# Perform PCA
pca = PCA(n_components=1)
capital_pca = pca.fit_transform(capital_df[numeric_columns])

# Add the PC1 values to the original dataframe
capital_df['PC1'] = capital_pca

# Display the first few rows of the dataframe with PC1 values
capital_df.head()

# Filter the data for the Middle Neolithic (3400-3000 BCE) and Younger Neolithic (2900-2300 BCE) periods
middle_neolithic = capital_df[(capital_df['BCE'] >= 3400) & (capital_df['BCE'] <= 3000)]
younger_neolithic = capital_df[(capital_df['BCE'] >= 2900) & (capital_df['BCE'] <= 2300)]

# Calculate the mean PC1 values for the Middle Neolithic and Younger Neolithic periods
middle_neolithic_mean = middle_neolithic['PC1'].mean()
younger_neolithic_mean = younger_neolithic['PC1'].mean()

middle_neolithic_mean, younger_neolithic_mean

capital_df['BCE'].min(), capital_df['BCE'].max()
